name: Business Identity Local - Italy
description: Adds Italian legal-requirement fields (CIN, Partita IVA, electronic invoicing/SDI, PEC, GDPR, REA/ATECO) to Business Identity's Local Laws tab.
project_description: Submodule of Business Identity providing Italian legal-requirement configuration fields via the Business Identity 'Local Laws' tab. Implements hook_business_identity_local_laws (Italy metadata), hook_business_identity_local_laws_fields (CIN, Partita IVA, VAT regime/rate, electronic-invoicing settings with SDI code and PEC email, GDPR/privacy fields, REA registration/office, share capital, ATECO code), hook_business_identity_local_laws_validate (CIN/VAT mod-10 checksum, SDI/PEC/ATECO format checks), and real hook_tokens/hook_token_info for [business:local_laws_it_*] tokens. Values are stored under business_identity.settings:local_laws.business_identity_local_it.
